claim_scope: BOTH (receiver input stage; no channel model)
design_commit: feature/issue-398 (the #398 adoption: design/aib_rx_data.spice is the supply-referenced stage selected by the #386 study, subckt rx__vref of sim/rx-threshold-study/cand_cells.inc, device sizes verbatim; the study's records/20261121T091822Z-mc/ is the study evidence for the same cell)

monte_carlo.negative_control_defect: input-pair NMOS (Mnp) made 4x narrower: w=0.25u ng=1 instead of w=1u ng=2 (gen_mc.py substitutes it into the inlined design cell); the same defect the study's control seeded
monte_carlo.control_sweep_deviation: the control's DC sweep is widened to Vfr 0.15-0.95 (the degraded cell crosses at fr 0.66-0.75 over the grid, outside the committed 0.3-0.7 window; the nominal bench keeps the committed window) -- the one stated deviation, carried by the #386 study control and by gen_mc.py

coverage_note: the grid varies MOS mismatch only (mos_*_mismatch sections); the divider is a pair of corner-section rppd resistors with no independent resistor-pair mismatch in this model set, same coverage as the study record and the committed 2026-11-08 record

supply_current.measurement: rx_up.ivdd_a, |i(vddio)| at the crossing point (input at the switching threshold, i.e. at VDDIO/2 by construction of the bench) of the same committed nominal request

note: T-10 PASSES on the adopted cell: klt yield pass at +-60 mV / 3 sigma, sigma-to-spec 5.96 (lower confidence bound 5.85 against 3), 0 of 5400 draws and 0 of 45 corners outside the limits, sample-size verdict sufficient (required 183), negative control detected (0 of 900 degraded draws in limit). Pooled mean +2.7 mV, sigma 9.6 mV, worst draw +42.3 mV; distribution consistent with normal (Anderson-Darling).
